t: You're looking at Selfridges, the Grade II listed department store on Oxford Street. It opened in 1909 and was designed by the American architect Daniel Burnham for Harry Gordon Selfridge, who commissioned it. Selfridge was an American retail magnate who became one of the most respected retailers in Britain, and was nicknamed the Earl of Oxford Street. Burnham was a leading figure of the Beaux-Arts movement. The store is the second largest department store in the United Kingdom, after Harrods.
